_comment.about: Config for the grafana-as-code scripts (lint.py, publish_dashboards.py, publish_alerts.py, verify_live.py). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Paths are relative to this file. Only dashboards_dir and alerts_dir are required; leaving any other key out switches its check off, and each script prints a one-line notice saying so. Unknown keys are an error, so a typo cannot silently disable a check. Credentials never go here: GRAFANA_URL and GRAFANA_API_TOKEN come from the environment.
_comment.dashboards_dir: Directory of dashboard JSON files, one dashboard per file.
_comment.alerts_dir: Directory of alert rule files in Grafana file-provisioning format (apiVersion: 1, groups -> rules), *.yaml or *.yml.
_comment.folder: The Grafana folder dashboards and rules publish to. Found by title; created with this uid only if no folder has the title. Required for publishing alert rules and for --prune.
_comment.dashboard_uid_prefix: Every dashboard uid must start with this. --prune deletes only dashboards in the folder with this prefix that no file defines, so it can never reach another app's dashboards.
_comment.rule_uid_prefix: Every rule uid must start with this. --prune and verify_live treat only prefixed rules as this app's.
_comment.scope: The matcher that pins a query to this app on a shared stack. label/value: a namespace-style label with one exact value. service_label/service_regex: a per-service label whose literal values must all fully match the regex. Either pair scopes a selector; give both if you have both. by (label) groups, it does not filter, so grouping clauses never count. traceql_attributes: a TraceQL query must match (= or =~) on at least one of these.
_comment.datasources: Datasource NAMES by kind (prometheus, loki, tempo). Dashboards reference datasources by these names; publish_dashboards rewrites them to {type, uid}. Lint rejects any other datasource name.
_comment.placeholders: Placeholder used in alert YAML datasourceUid -> datasource kind. ${PROMETHEUS_DS_UID} is resolved to the uid of datasources.prometheus at publish time, so the YAML never holds a uid.
_comment.contact_point: The contact point publish_alerts provisions, and the receiver every rule must name in notification_settings.receiver. The address comes from the environment variable addresses_env. Other types: set type (slack, webhook, ...), static settings in settings, and secret settings as setting -> env var name in settings_env. The notification-policy tree is never touched.
_comment.required_rule_labels: Labels every rule must carry with exactly these values, e.g. the label an alert-list panel filters on.
_comment.allowed_variables: Template variables a dashboard query may use besides the ones the dashboard defines (typically Grafana built-ins). A $name that is neither is an error: Grafana leaves it unresolved and the panel shows No data. A scope matcher whose value is a variable (service_name=~"$service") is accepted only if the variable is defined or listed here.
_comment.grid_columns: Width of the dashboard grid. Grafana's is 24; this is the one optional key with a default.
